tools.name: infermedica_list_symptoms
tools.description: List all symptoms in the Infermedica medical model (optionally age-filtered). Engine API: GET /symptoms.

tools.name: infermedica_get_symptom
tools.description: Get a single symptom by its id. Engine API: GET /symptoms/{id}.

tools.name: infermedica_list_conditions
tools.description: List all conditions (diseases) in the Infermedica medical model. Engine API: GET /conditions.

tools.name: infermedica_get_condition
tools.description: Get a single condition by its id. Engine API: GET /conditions/{id}.

tools.name: infermedica_list_risk_factors
tools.description: List all risk factors in the Infermedica medical model. Engine API: GET /risk_factors.

tools.name: infermedica_get_risk_factor
tools.description: Get a single risk factor by its id. Engine API: GET /risk_factors/{id}.

tools.name: infermedica_list_lab_tests
tools.description: List all lab tests (and their results) in the Infermedica medical model. Engine API: GET /lab_tests.

tools.name: infermedica_get_lab_test
tools.description: Get a single lab test by its id. Engine API: GET /lab_tests/{id}.

tools.name: infermedica_search_concepts
tools.description: Search the medical concept database for observations matching a phrase (autocomplete). Engine API: GET /search.

tools.name: infermedica_get_info
tools.description: Get metadata about the current Infermedica medical model (version, last update, concept counts). Engine API: GET /info.

tools.name: infermedica_diagnosis
tools.description: Run the diagnostic engine over the collected evidence — returns the next question to ask, ranked candidate conditions with probabilities, and a should_stop flag. Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /diagnosis.

tools.name: infermedica_triage
tools.description: Recommend a triage level (emergency_ambulance | emergency | consultation_24 | consultation | self_care) plus any serious/emergency observations, given the evidence. Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /triage.

tools.name: infermedica_explain
tools.description: Explain which evidence supports or conflicts with a given target condition, for the collected evidence. Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /explain.

tools.name: infermedica_suggest
tools.description: Suggest additional symptoms/observations the patient is likely to have, to speed up the interview. Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /suggest.

tools.name: infermedica_rationale
tools.description: Explain WHY the diagnostic engine wants to ask its next question, given the evidence. Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /rationale.

tools.name: infermedica_parse
tools.description: Extract clinical mentions (symptoms / risk factors) and their states from free-text describing complaints, mapping them to Infermedica evidence ids (NLP). Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /parse.

tools.name: infermedica_recommend_specialist
tools.description: Recommend the most appropriate medical specialist and consultation channel for the collected evidence (accepts the same body as diagnosis/triage). Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /recommend_specialist.
